title: Setting a price on a free tier shows what Business adds, with keeping it free as an equal choice
detail: PHASE 5 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). One panel wherever a Member, Crew Host or free Space sets a price (Event, membership, Journey, booking, product): what Business adds, start its 14-day trial in place, or keep it free and receive tips. The draft is kept either way. A generic upgrade event is logged with no wellness detail. Lands with LIVE-753 so the gate never dead-ends. Shipped 2026-10-06: components/pricing/upgrade-moment.tsx lists what Business adds (lib/pricing/payments-copy.ts, the price read from the catalog by lib/pricing/business-offer.ts), starts the Business trial in place through startSpaceLoadoutCheckout and CheckoutPanel for the Space owner (hosted fallback in a new tab), gives Keep it free equal weight, never touches the draft, and logs pricing.upgrade_moment with surface, action and scope only; mounted on the Event form, the membership tier editor, the new-service Spark and the personal product Spark, and a payments refusal from createEvent or setMembershipTiers opens it. Journeys are not wired: the paid-Journey gate already refuses free sellers and there is no Journey price editor to mount on.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const f="components/pricing/upgrade-moment.tsx";const s=r(f);if(!s)fail("no upgrade moment panel");if(!/[Kk]eep it free/.test(s))fail("the panel offers no keep-it-free choice");const walk=(d,o=[])=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=d+"/"+e.name;if(e.isDirectory())walk(p,o);else if(/\.tsx$/.test(e.name))o.push(p)}return o};const n=walk("app").filter((p)=>/upgrade-moment/.test(r(p))).length;if(n<3)fail("the panel is mounted on "+n+" price surfaces, want Event, membership and booking at least");console.log("ok: the upgrade moment is on the price surfaces")'
